summary: Skip index refreshes and commit-observer evaluations for unchanged or rolled-back writer loans, with native committed-table dependency routing

replay.detail: No replay or projection semantics change.

compatibility.detail: Existing startup drains and real deadlines remain active. Writer observation work counters are exposed through the performance endpoint. Custom SQLite builds must enable SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK; bundled builds enable it automatically.

recovery.detail: Lost native observation coverage conservatively invalidates dependent readers. SQLite builds missing required native hook support refuse writer initialization.
